preflight.bound_hash.required_outcome: Every bound identity must match current bytes.

preflight.instructions_differ.required_outcome: All installed instruction copies must be byte-identical.

preflight.unlisted_file.required_outcome: Every tool file must be listed in MANIFEST.sha256.

preflight.symlink.required_outcome: Tool and control paths must contain no unexpected symlink.

preflight.reused_hash.required_outcome: A reused tool must match its manifest identity before execution.

preflight.state_history.required_outcome: The protected state and complete linked factual-update history must resolve.

preflight.agent_mapping.required_outcome: Every agent instruction file must have exactly one matching configuration entry.

preflight.binding_mismatch.required_outcome: Only an owner binding of the current manifest may enable blocking results.

scope.excluded.required_outcome: Every read, cited and changed path must resolve inside the permitted allowlist.

scope.draft_approved.required_outcome: Only matching files in START_MANIFEST.md may be cited as approved.

scope.package_span.required_outcome: Changes must stay in one package surface or cite an explicit wider Plan or grant boundary.

citation.missing_file.required_outcome: The cited file must exist in an allowed location.

citation.hash_mismatch.required_outcome: The citation hash must match the current cited bytes.

citation.line_range.required_outcome: The cited line range must exist and be ordered.

citation.quote_not_found.required_outcome: The exact nonempty quote must occur within the cited line range.

citation.upstream_identity.required_outcome: The cited upstream repository, pinned commit, path, lines and file hash must resolve.

citation.command_mismatch.required_outcome: A retained execution record and raw outputs must reproduce the stated command, exit and hashes.

report.headers.required_outcome: The first three non-empty report lines must open with NOT DONE:, Full Blast Radius Check:, then Enforcement Self-Check:.

report.table.required_outcome: The eleven-group engineering inventory must stay in the retained record, not the chat report.

report.label.required_outcome: Every material claim must carry exactly one permitted evidence label.

report.inference.required_outcome: An inference may not establish a decision, requirement or test expectation.

report.completion.required_outcome: Completion wording must have explicit scope and proof with no unchecked applicable group.

report.counts.required_outcome: Reported coverage counts must equal counts computed from the inventory.

report.groups.required_outcome: Engineering coverage must enumerate every group once with concrete items or a supported exclusion.

report.claim_missing.required_outcome: Each machine-readable claim must appear in the submitted report.

authority.remote.required_outcome: Every push URL must equal the literal DISABLED or be an owner-approved xorewa repository target.

authority.upstream_endpoint.required_outcome: No recorded operation may contact a MultiversX network, gateway or public API.

authority.grant.required_outcome: Every consequential operation must cite an applicable, unexpired owner grant.

secret.pem.required_outcome: Changed content must contain no private-key PEM block.

secret.keystore.required_outcome: Changed content must contain no credential-bearing keystore structure.

secret.assignment.required_outcome: Changed content must contain no non-placeholder key or credential assignment.

secret.filename.required_outcome: A denied credential filename must not enter the change.

qual.test_name.required_outcome: TestQual functions must live only in qual_*_test.go files.

qual.file_name.required_outcome: Qualification Go files must use qual_*_test.go and TestQual entry points.

qual.driver.required_outcome: Standalone qualification drivers must remain outside product modules.

rerun.exit.required_outcome: A smoke-tested approved rerun must reproduce the claimed exit status.

rerun.output.required_outcome: A rerun must reproduce the exact retained stdout and stderr hashes.

rerun.toolchain.required_outcome: Go commands must use the locked binary with GOTOOLCHAIN=local.

agent.unsupported.required_outcome: A finding must include currently resolvable evidence supporting its criterion.

orchestrate.history.required_outcome: Prior verdict and report identities must match the retained iteration chain.

orchestrate.recurrence.required_outcome: A reappeared defect requires owner disposition.

orchestrate.no_progress.required_outcome: An unchanged nonempty blocking defect set requires owner disposition.

orchestrate.repair_bound.required_outcome: A repair bound may not be exceeded.

rerun.unselected.required_outcome: A cited command without an owner-selected rerun is reported without execution or loss of other check results.

report.unbacked_token.required_outcome: Every response fact token must resolve to its mechanically valid claims evidence.

carry.missing_section.required_outcome: A Markdown delivery or audit record must contain a CARRY_FORWARD section listing every obligation it finds with its receiving row, owner, or none (Addendum 14 §2; audit aspect C1).

carry.unrouted.required_outcome: Every CARRY_FORWARD entry must name the receiving row (SP2-xx, Txx), the owner, or none.

rerun.outcome.required_outcome: An automatic rerun of a cited go test must reproduce every cited per-test outcome (pass, fail or skip) from go test -json.

carry.not_landed.required_outcome: A CARRY_FORWARD entry that hands an obligation to a tracker row must quote text now present in that row, or state that the row does not hold it and request an owner tracker carry (Addendum 15 item 2; audit aspect C1).
